description: Complex oscillator: two analogue oscillators with wavefolders, a signal multiplier and internal modulation routings between them

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of that oscillator
Tunes that oscillator finely around the setting of its COARSE knob
Routes the index controlled sine waves into the opposite oscillator's PWM CV input: white for both directions, amber for oscillator A into oscillator B alone
Sets the duty cycle of oscillator A's pulse wave, over a range that stays audible without external control voltage
Sets the octave of oscillator B's square output: unlit at the fundamental, white one octave down, amber two octaves down
Sets the width of the upper and lower pulses of oscillator B's stepped triangle wave
Sets the level driven into the multiplier, reaching unity with the pointer at about two o'clock and clipping harmonically beyond it
Sets what the multiplier does with the modulator input: unlit for four quadrant ring modulation, white for half wave rectification, amber for full wave rectification
Drops oscillator A into sub-audio range, where it keeps tracking a volt per octave and resets on each rising edge at the hard sync input
Sets that oscillator's FM input to linear scaling on the left or exponential on the right
Sets the depth of frequency modulation reaching that oscillator
Normals a pitch voltage at either 1V/OCT input to both oscillators, and a second pitch voltage breaks that normal
Sets the gain of the two internal VCAs that carry the sine waves to the internal modulation destinations
Attenuates and inverts the index CV input before it sums with the INDEX knob, despite the maker naming it Index Button, the name it also gives the routing button
Held down, the six other buttons switch their internal modulation routings on and off, lighting white where a routing is enabled
Sets the internal sync routing: amber sends oscillator A's ramp to oscillator B's soft sync, white sends oscillator B's square to oscillator A's hard sync
Sets the DC offset added to that oscillator's sine wave before folding, and scales a signal patched into its symmetry bias input; the centre is calibrated to 0V
Attenuates and inverts that oscillator's wavefold CV input
Sets how far that oscillator's sine wave is folded, near silence at the left and a dense harmonic timbre at the right

inputs.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch at a volt per octave, summed with its COARSE and FINE knobs
Modulates that oscillator's pulse width, -5V to 5V summed with its PWM knob
The modulator side of the multiplier, normalled to oscillator A's sine wave, and the side the rectification modes act on
The carrier side of the multiplier, normalled to oscillator B's sine wave
Frequency modulation of that oscillator, scaled by its FM knob; unpatched it takes the other oscillator's sine wave
Modulates the index, scaled by its attenuverter and summed with the INDEX knob
A rising edge above 2.5V resets oscillator A's cycle
A rising edge above 2V flips the charge direction of oscillator B's triangle core, locking it to integer multiples of the incoming frequency
Replaces the DC reference feeding that oscillator's bias attenuverter, and sums with the sine wave before the folding stage
Modulates that oscillator's folding amount, scaled by its wavefold attenuverter

outputs.text: Oscillator A's sawtooth wave, the reference amplitude at 10Vpp
Oscillator A's sine wave after the wavefolder and its symmetry bias
Oscillator A's pulse wave, at the duty cycle set by its PWM knob
Oscillator B's square wave, at the octave set by the SUB button
Oscillator B's sine wave after the wavefolder and its symmetry bias
Oscillator B's stepped triangle wave, at the pulse width set by its PWM knob
The product of the two multiplier inputs, at the level set by DEPTH and in the mode set by the RING AM RECT button

menu: Osc A to Osc B Routing: FM, Symmetry, Wavefold — switches each destination on or off for the index controlled sine wave oscillator A sends into oscillator B
Osc B to Osc A Routing: FM, Symmetry, Wavefold — switches each destination on or off for the index controlled sine wave oscillator B sends into oscillator A

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.9: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.10: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
